label: A_hP4_194_bc-001
title: Hexagonal Graphite ($A9$) Structure
comments:
According to (Wyckoff, 1963), hexagonal graphite may be either \href{current_web_home_dir/A_hP4_194_bc-001}{flat, space group $P6_{3}/mmc$ \#194} (this structure) or \href{current_web_home_dir/A_hP4_186_ab-001}{buckled, space group $P6_{3}mc$ \#186}. We assign the $A9$ {\em Strukturbericht} designation to the unbuckled structure shown here. 
 Experimentally, a \href{current_web_home_dir/A_hR2_166_c-002}{rhombohedral ($R\overline{3}m$) graphite structure} is also observed. 
 Carbon can also be found in nature as \href{current_web_home_dir/A_cF8_227_a-001}{cubic diamond ($A4$)}, \href{current_web_home_dir/A_hP4_194_f-001}{lonsdaleite (hexagonal diamond}}, and \href{current_web_home_dir/A_cP240_205_10d-001}{buckminsterfullerene (C$_{60}$)}.
